subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Leo looked down, ready to be scolded.”?
options: The teacher asked students what gates mean today.
The teacher asked, "Does this mean the cold seed is dead"
The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.
The teacher asked quietly if everything was all right.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked students what gates mean today.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked, 'Does this mean the cold seed is dead'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Leo looked down, ready to be scolded. The teacher asked quietly if everything was all right.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
